## Review checklist

- [ ] Public code, prompts, examples, fixtures and docs use neutral synthetic data.
- [ ] Tenant routing, credentials and organizational policy remain private caller config.
- [ ] Optional component dependencies and code-enforced permission boundaries are preserved.
- [ ] Migration and validation claims match the actual implementation/evidence.
